checks.check: Unassigned row pinned first, reps A-Z by name (S22-R4, Key Decisions "Rep ordering is plain A->Z")
Rep row = sum of its invoice rows, (n) = its invoices (S5-R4, S5-R6)
Every rep row has at least one invoice (contributors only, S5-R1)
Invoice rows newest first, same-day ties by invoice number (S6-R9)
Rep name tagged (Inactive) only for an inactive rep (S5-R9)
Each invoice appears under exactly one rep or Unassigned (S6-R7, single-rep build)
Listed invoice is not void / reversed
Labor Invoiced = labor on the invoice (+ labor-line fees/discounts)
Parts Invoiced = parts on the invoice (+ part-line fees/discounts)
Shop Supplies = the invoice shop-supply charge (S5-R13)
Subtotal = invoice pre-tax total
Adjustments = invoice-level fees minus discounts (S5-R11)
Row ties out: Labor + Parts + Shop Supplies + Adjustments = Subtotal (S5-R12)
Row ties out: Labor Margin + Parts Margin + Adjustments = Margin (S5-R12)
Margin % = Margin / Margin base x 100, "—" when base <= 0 (§3)
Labor Delta = hours invoiced - hours worked (row fields) (§3, S9-R2)
Hours invoiced = billed labor hours on the work order (Stats tab)
Hours worked = technician clocked hours on the work order (Stats tab)
Labor Margin = Labor Invoiced - the shop labor cost (Stats tab)
Parts Margin = Parts Invoiced - the shop parts cost (Stats tab)
Status badge = the five-state -> three-value mapping in §3 (spec text)
